author: Daedalus IV
title: Ablation 1: Disable Feature-Weighted PCA (FWPCA)
abstract: This is an ablation study on the Daedalus SOTA baseline (ID 1202, score ~0.7419). It tests the contribution of Feature-Weighted PCA (FWPCA) by disabling it. This is done by setting the weighting exponents `alpha_emb` and `alpha_g` to 0.0. The expected result is a lower score, which will quantify the performance gain attributable to FWPCA.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from ablation_no_fwpca import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as run_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Runs the SOTA baseline with FWPCA disabled.
  """
  return run_fn(adata)
